notes: Coffee with Sarah. MedLoop is preparing to raise a $4M seed round in November and she explicitly asked if I know healthcare investors - she wants intros to funds that do digital health. They've signed 2 hospital pilots. Also looking for an experienced enterprise sales advisor who has sold into health systems, since none of the founders has done that. She offered to connect any founder I know with clinicians from her advisory network.

Lunch with Michael. Northbeam just closed Fund III. He said he wants to see more early-stage digital health deals - seed and Series A, especially AI tools for hospitals. He's actively looking and asked me to send good founders his way. Also mentioned his portfolio companies always need help with go-to-market and brand.

Caught up with Priya. She left HealthGrid in the spring after 9 years running enterprise sales into hospital systems. She told me she wants 2-3 advisory roles with early-stage healthcare startups, ideally with equity. Very open to meeting founders.

Zoom with David. Ledgerline is hiring a VP of Engineering - their last search fell through and he needs someone by Q1 who has scaled payments infrastructure. He also mentioned he knows a lot of people in the payments regulatory world and is happy to help founders navigate compliance.

Elena reached out privately. She's quietly exploring VP Engineering roles at fintech startups - wants to lead a team building payments infrastructure. Please keep it confidential. She's led the Paystream ledger rebuild for 3 years.

Dinner with Tom. Routewise is focused on landing mid-size retail customers for their delivery routing software - he'd love intros to operations leaders at retail chains. He was clear he does not want investor intros right now. He offered to share their pricing playbook with any SaaS founder.

Met Grace at the retail ops summit. Brightmart is evaluating delivery and routing software vendors this quarter - their current system is failing and she has budget approved for Q4. She asked if I know any good vendors.
Chatted briefly with Marcus at a conference reception. He's a startup CEO. We didn't get into much detail - mostly talked about the conference talks.
Ran into James. He mentioned that a friend of his is looking for healthcare investors, but didn't say who. Coinvault itself is doing fine and he didn't ask for anything.
Olivia wants to launch a founder-led podcast for Bloom & Co to build B2B wholesale relationships. She's looking for a production agency that understands B2B and wants to launch by January.
Ben's agency Signal Studio produces B2B podcasts end-to-end - strategy, guest booking, editing. They have capacity for two new clients this fall and he asked me for referrals.
Kevin said Tallgrass needs office space in Austin before their January move. Asked if I knew any commercial real estate brokers.
Hannah said Sequel is focused on Series A and B healthcare and fintech companies with at least $2M ARR. Reiterated she doesn't look at seed deals.
Rachel runs a recruiting firm and asked me to introduce her to as many startup CEOs as possible so she can pitch her recruiting services.

[DEMO - fictional] Coffee with Will in South Lake Union. He's an engineer on Amazon Q in Seattle and wants to meet founders using LLMs in production for a side project on cost-efficient inference. Asked if I know anyone hiring for applied AI roles in Seattle next spring. He offered to review architecture for any startup I know that's building on AWS. Big into hackathons.
